answer: Medical Services Support: Reinvested to offset the unreimbursed cost of providing primary care services and maintain patient access.
Dental Services Support: Support the delivery of dental services and reduce the financial burden of providing care.
Behavioral Health Services Support: Sustain behavioral health services and improve access to mental health and substance use treatment.

All 340B revenue is maintained separately from the organization's operating revenue to ensure transparency, accountability, and appropriate stewardship of program funds.

Any excess 340B funds are reinvested into the 340B program or used to support eligible patient programs and services that directly improve patient access to care
